source.title: 原文截图
source.note: 原始 PDF 直接渲染，保留原文排版；非重排文字或 AI 重画。
source.hint: 点击图片可放大；“查看整页”保留上下文。
source.fullnote: 整页截图。定位框仅为界面标记，可关闭，不修改原图。
source.pagenote: 页码按附件 PDF 的页序；放大后可滚动查看。
source.shortcut: 查看这段代码对应的原文截图

translation.heading: 中文译文
translation.tableHint: 中文表格，可横向滚动查看全部列
translation.sourceHeading: 原文截图 + 中文译文
translation.galleryHint: 中文译文逐段对应当前截图，可折叠；图表文字另列对照。点击原图可并排放大阅读。
translation.fullScope: 当前显示整页原图，译文仅对应定位框选中的截图区域，不是本页全文翻译。
translation.cropScope: 译文对应当前局部截图。公式、数据和原文示例按截图保留；另列的译注不是作者原文。
translation.pageScope: 当前为整页浏览。请选择本页的一处已译截图，在整页上定位并显示对应译文；未选区域不冒充全文翻译。
translation.noPage: 本页没有收录对应局部截图，未提供本页全文翻译。
translation.viewerNote: 原图与对应译文同步切换。放大只改变显示比例，不改变图片或译文；数值及英文 token 仍以原图为准。
translation.indexIntro: 已收录 {regions} 处局部截图，其中 {translated} 处提供对应译文。按原 PDF 页序排列；仅覆盖所选区域，不代表全文翻译。
translation.shortcut: 查看对应原文截图及中文译文
translation.about: 原文截图 {regions} 处，对应译文 {translated} 处。译文、译注、作者论证解读和代码解释分开标识。整页图仅用于上下文定位，不自动代表整页已译。

source.title: Source screenshots
source.note: Rendered from source PDF pixels; not retyped text or a generated reconstruction.
source.hint: Enlarge the region, or open the full page for surrounding context.
source.fullnote: Full-page view. The locator is a removable interface overlay, not an edit to the source image.
source.pagenote: Page numbers follow PDF file order. Scroll after zooming.
source.shortcut: Open the source region for this code

translation.heading: Translation
translation.noTranslation: No translation is available for this region.
translation.tableHint: Translated table; scroll horizontally to inspect all columns
translation.galleryHint: The translation belongs to this exact crop. Figure labels are listed separately; interpretation is not inserted into the translation.
translation.fullScope: The image shows a full page. The translation only covers the selected rectangle, not the whole page.
translation.cropScope: Translation of this selected crop. Formula symbols, data and literal examples are preserved; translator notes are separate.
translation.pageScope: Full-page context. Select one of this page's regions to display its translation.
translation.noPage: No selected region is recorded for this page; no full-page translation is claimed.
translation.viewerNote: Source and translation switch together. Zoom changes display scale, not the source or translation.
translation.indexIntro: {regions} source regions; {translated} translated regions. Ordered by PDF page. This covers selected regions, not the whole manuscript.
translation.about: {regions} source regions; {translated} translated regions. Source translations, translator notes, author-argument interpretation and code explanations remain distinct. Full pages provide context, not a claim of full-page translation.
